## Pre-Foundation authorship gate

- [ ] Every human author and co-author of this change is identified.
- [ ] This change was authored solely by Jack Li, or a separately signed rights instrument has been reviewed outside GitHub.
- [ ] No external patch, code excerpt, documentation, specification, design asset, benchmark material, prompt, relay material, or substantive authored text has been incorporated without written clearance.
- [ ] No employer, university, client, or other organization plausibly owns any submitted material, unless a written entity authorization has been reviewed.
- [ ] `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, copyright ownership, repository visibility, canonical repository ownership, and Git history are unchanged unless the pull request expressly documents prior written authorization.
- [ ] No signed legal document, signature image, address, credential, or private access inventory is included.
